pr_body:
This PR exposes via the x-pack usage API the health api stats that #91559 has collected.
 
Closes #90877.
pr_title: Expose Health Api telemetry via xpack

I believe this is happening because I haven't configured properly that this is not available before `8.7`. Working on it.

I believe I have found the issue.

When the node receiving the xpack request was on `8.7.0` then it would request the health api stats from the rest of the clusters. If there was at least one node in a previous version, then it wouldn't be able to fulfill this request. We fixed this in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/91708/commits/16d52ff6dec3f578cbd8756733e36945e75cddfe, we propose to only collect the health api stats if the whole cluster is after `8.7.0`, otherwise to respond:
```
{
  "available": false,
  "enabled": true
}
```
Meaning the health api is enabled but the stats were not available. @andreidan what do you think?
